links.outcome: GPT-4o versus fine-tuned Clinical Longformer baseline on PE extraction from impressions, same validation data
links.effect: GPT-4o outperformed Clinical Longformer on two metrics: sensitivity 1.0 (95% CI 1.0-1.0; p<0.001) and F1 0.975 (95% CI 0.9495-0.9947; p<0.001) on validation set.
links.quote: GPT-4o outperformed the Clinical Longformer in two of the metrics, achieving a sensitivity of 1.0 (95% CI: [1.0, 1.0]; Wilcoxon test, p < 0.001) and an F1 score of 0.975 (95% CI: [0.9495, 0.9947]; Wilcoxon test, p < 0.001) across the validation dataset.

links.outcome: Post-deployment performance of deployed GPT-4o on 200 operational records
links.effect: Sensitivity 1.0 (95% CI 1.0-1.0), specificity 0.94 (95% CI 0.8913-0.9804), F1 0.97 (95% CI 0.9479-0.9908) on 200 operational records.
links.quote: Post-deployment evaluations also showed strong performance of the deployed GPT-4o model with a sensitivity of 1.0 (95% CI: [1.0, 1.0]), a specificity of 0.94 (95% CI: [0.8913, 0.9804]), and an F1 score of 0.97 (95% CI: [0.9479, 0.9908]).

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4o for extracting pulmonary embolism diagnoses from radiology report impressions, including validation and post-deployment evaluation on operational records, but focuses purely on model accuracy rather than evaluating a specific safeguard or deployment practice.
